precedence: Apply after R171 REVIEW_AMENDMENTS.json. Suspended raw rules cannot be used; effective predicates below are typed application obligations, not additional raw graph nodes.

types.frame_instance: Actual R166 frame installation on t; not schema availability
types.local_instance: Actually discharged R172 local component certificate instance on t
types.compat_instance: Every clause of R172 Compat_gamma holds on t with retained discharge; neither theorem schema nor J is sufficient
types.cert_positive: W/E-indexed positive use evidence; NOT an internal physical relation
types.role_bridge: Independently justified same-baseline-mechanism, realized-route, fidelity/locality and identification bridge from evidence to selected executed path
types.same_binding: All premises concern the identical t tuple; identity is checked independently of Boolean premise values
types.witnessed_path_record: Support record containing t and frame/local/compat/cert/bridge discharges; a record is not a physical constituent
types.C1_instance: The same actual D/Phi/h instance is admitted under C1; not derived
types.K_grounding: phi_path primitives have independent actual K interpretations and well-sorted actual witnesses
types.parameter_transport: All declared actual internal parameters p map to h(p); W and E are external
types.common_comparison_signature: Independently grounded type correspondence for both tokens; no total experiential identity follows

actual_selector.formula: Anchor(b) AND Bind(b,k) AND EXISTS q,e1,e2 [TransferOccurrence(k,q,gamma,e1) AND OperandUseOccurrence(q,a,e2) AND SameEpisodeOrdered(e1,e2)]
actual_selector.compatibility_placement: side condition retained in the application evidence; not assumed to be an internal K-relation
actual_selector.scope: A selected actually executed operand path; not every causal contribution, not necessary output sensitivity, not familiar mineness
actual_selector.grounding_obligation: Independent physical interpretations of transfer, operand-use and temporal predicates; merely declaring symbols is insufficient

effective_rules.proof: Retain all discharged same-instance obligations; apply the independently justified evidence-to-role bridge; no inversion of a conditional.

effective_rules.conclusion: Conditional phi_path counterpart inside Phi, with explicit h(p); B_min/F_O/F_A remains open
effective_rules.proof: Apply R157 T1 to the grounded actual selector, not to W, a certificate or a global proof obligation.

effective_rules.conclusion: Compare selected grounded phi_path structures only; no full-type identity, mineness, richness or basal-existence inference
effective_rules.proof: Each bearer separately satisfies the corrected instance/transport contract; restrict the conclusion to the selected common signature.

node_overrides.R172:INTERFACE_COMPOSITION_THEOREM: Conditional theorem schema. Any applied joint-invariant record must retain local_instance and compat_instance explicitly; bare theorem/J cannot project them.
node_overrides.R172:ONLINE_ACTION_USE_RELATION: Read archived LiveUse(t|W,E) as a sufficient evidence package, not automatically an internal organization predicate. OnticUse_path is defined in the response independently of W/E.
node_overrides.R172:WITNESSED_ONLINE_ACTION_USE: Typed support record with explicit compatibility and evidence-to-role bridge. Not itself a physical K-relation.
node_overrides.R172:EXPERIENCE_INTERNAL_ACTION_COORDINA: Use corrected phi_path and transported physical parameters only after independent grounding. Do not silently equate with the old theta_EBA certificate conjunction.
node_overrides.R172:BIO_AI_APPLICATION_BOUNDARY: Uses the corrected selected-path applications for each token; all previous nonidentity and semantic limits persist.

limits: No new numbered round or raw node count
